title: Chef de Partie
summary: Join the kitchen team at Novotel London Blackfriars and take responsibility for a designated section during service. You will prepare food consistently, control ingredient quality, manage stock and waste, and keep the section organised. The role also involves supporting senior chefs, helping junior colleagues develop, and creating an enjoyable experience for hotel and restaurant guests.
responsibilities: Prepare and run a designated kitchen section for each service
Control the quality of ingredients and prepared food
Manage stock, waste, cleanliness, and organisation
Support senior chefs and help junior colleagues develop
required_qualifications: Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced service
Consistent food preparation and quality control
